title: Nioh
summary: Cutscene runs with sound and no picture. Its video is WMV3, which the fix decodes itself where the engine cannot. Runs on DXMT only.

credits.name: winevideo
credits.note: Independent confirmation of the shared-texture cutscene path, which winevideo repairs inside a patched Wine d3d9.dll.

excerpts.note: Wine's d3d9 answers a shared render target with S_OK and a null handle; where it leaves that hole, the bridge hands the game a real shared handle.

cause: Two faults, the first hiding the second: no CrossOver ships a WMV3 decoder, so the DirectShow graph never builds; and the D3D9 render target the game asks to share comes back with a null share handle.
